summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  **What I found from reading the code (no changes made):**  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → auth cookie → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → DB. Contrary to what the symptom suggests, the current code looks correctly wired end to end:  - Every watchlist route requires a valid `arca_session` cookie and derives `userId` server-side from the session — there's no anonymous fallback, no client-supplied user id, no default/guest watchlist. - Every query (list, get, create, add item, remove item, delete) filters
